h: Right in the middle of town
p: West Street is a proper central spot: Broad Street, the main shopping drag, is at one end, and Reading station is only a few minutes' walk north via Friar Street. That makes this an easy one to drop into if you're in town for the shops or waiting on a train.

If you've got time to kill, The Oracle and the riverside along the Kennet are a short stroll south, and Forbury Gardens, with its big Maiwand Lion statue, sits beside the ruins of Reading Abbey on the east side of the centre. Henry I is buried somewhere under that abbey site, which is a decent pub-quiz fact to take home.
It's an 18+ venue, so carry ID if you look young.
